# Remote & Hybrid Work Policy

*Tidewater Health — People Team. Effective 1 November 2026.*

**Who this applies to:** all salaried staff in non-clinical roles.

### Where you can work
You may work from home up to three days a week, agreed with your manager. Clinical and front-desk roles are excluded because they need to be on site.

### Home office equipment
Tidewater will reimburse up to $600 every two years for a desk, chair, monitor or headset. Submit the itemised receipt through the expense tool within 60 days of purchase. Receipts must show the vendor, date and amount paid; card statements alone are not enough. We do not reimburse internet bills.

### Working hours
Core hours are 10:00–15:00 local time. Outside of those, arrange your day with your team.

### Security
Only use your Tidewater laptop for work. Never take patient records home on paper.

Questions go to people@tidewaterhealth.example.
